ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio of high-intensity pixels to low-intensity pixels; surface is approximately 90% dark-valued (black/dark grey) with high-contrast white focal points providing localized intensity spikes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Absence of contiguous white banding; mapping consists of hundreds of discrete, high-contrast white circular spots (5-15 pixel diameter) distributed semi-randomly across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 55 degrees and a vertical depth extending significantly into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous boundary exhibiting low-amplitude irregular serrations; frequency of peaks increases towards the lateral tips where topography becomes more jagged.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex upward curve extending from the median notch to the distal tips of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density spatial detection of circular white pixel clusters (rosettes) across the entire visible surface, representing a characteristic 'polka-dot' distribution.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions; notably a series of diagonal rake-like marks on the upper mid-section of the right lobe (image-right).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized clusters of high-relief, textured tan/white pixel groups at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes, consistent with calcified biological attachments.
other_distinctive_markers: Extremely high density of circular scarring relative to typical baseline observations for this species, covering >15% of the total ventral surface area.
